summary: A new installation checks itself before it says done, and alerts reach someone from day one.

new.title: The install checks itself before finishing
new.text: The last install step shows one table of what is in place, repairs what it can and gives the exact command for anything left.

new.title: Alert recipients set during install
new.text: The install sets alert recipients to the address you give or your SuperAdmins' mail, so alerts reach someone from the first engine run.

new.title: Mail checked piece by piece
new.text: Get Started > Mail sender and the Overview check each part of mail separately and show the one-line fix for each missing piece. You can skip mail for now.

new.title: Pro Business and Pro Enterprise shown
new.text: The header, Licence page and Get Started show your Pro edition. Pro Business warns from 90% of its admin account limit; nothing running is ever switched off.

fixes.title: New Exchange organisations no longer fail mail setup
fixes.text: On a brand-new Exchange organisation, the install now waits up to about an hour for Exchange to accept the send right, showing progress.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Installs through the Invardia Support app now report each step to Invardia.
